svg.title: Abu Dhabi buildings — identification guide
svg.desc: Independent editable vector groups based on the supplied Abu Dhabi illustration. Transparent background. No embedded raster image. Heights reflect the illustration, not measured building heights.

g.title: Background building 01
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Far left, below Capital Gate. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Capital Gate
g.desc: High identification. Leaning lattice tower at far left. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Slanted glass building
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Small glass building in front of Capital Gate. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Aldar Headquarters
g.desc: High identification. Circular building at left. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Background building 02
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Striped block behind Aldar Headquarters. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Small minaret / decorative tower
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Small ornate tower between Aldar and Al Bahar. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Rounded-top skyscraper
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Tall curved tower behind Al Bahar; identity cannot be established. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Al Bahar Towers — left
g.desc: High identification. Left tower of patterned twin towers. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Al Bahar Towers — right
g.desc: High identification. Right tower of patterned twin towers. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: ADNOC Headquarters
g.desc: High identification. Central rectangular tower with open frame at top. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Burj Mohammed bin Rashid
g.desc: Probable identification. Taller central blade-shaped tower, probable WTC residential tower. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: WTC Trust Tower
g.desc: Probable identification. Shorter central blade-shaped tower, probable WTC office tower. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Gate Towers — visible tower 1
g.desc: Probable identification. Foreground central linked complex, tower 1 from left; individual top-cap section retained. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Gate Towers — visible tower 2
g.desc: Probable identification. Foreground central linked complex, tower 2 from left; individual top-cap section retained. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Gate Towers — visible tower 3
g.desc: Probable identification. Foreground central linked complex, tower 3 from left; individual top-cap section retained. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Background building 03
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Narrow gridded building right of the WTC towers. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Angular tower — left
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Left of three towers behind the mosque; Etihad Towers association uncertain. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Slender ribbed tower
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Narrow tower directly behind left mosque dome. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Angular tower — right
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Right of three towers behind the mosque; Etihad Towers association uncertain. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Background building 04
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Tall rectangular block behind mosque, right of central dome. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
g.desc: High identification. Domes and minarets on the right. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Background building 05
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Rectangular building beyond right mosque minaret. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Background building 06
g.desc: Unidentified identification. Small low block at far right. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.

g.title: Sheikh Zayed Bridge
g.desc: Probable identification. Undulating bridge across the foreground; separate non-building asset. Hand-drawn vector approximation; occluded portions reconstructed.
